name: Admiral Scrap
description: A woman in her mid forties who drives a welded fish-shaped art car across a desert festival playa and sings fuzzed-out surf-psych rock, loud, commanding and delighted.
build: A sturdy, strong-shouldered adult woman of ordinary proportions: solid arms, a straight torso, a natural waist, legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Sun-browned light olive skin, hazel eyes under strong dark brows, a straight nose, high cheekbones, fine sun lines at the eye corners and wide lips.
hair: Thick wavy auburn-red hair to the shoulders, pushed back from the face by a band of round brass welding goggles worn up on the forehead.
outfit: A hip-length double-breasted captain's coat built of riveted copper-and-brass sheet plates, a stand-up collar, two rows of six large round brass buttons, sleeves ending at the wrists so both hands are bare; a plain teal cotton vest under it; dark oxblood canvas work trousers, straight-legged; knee-high dusty black lace-up boots; a wide black leather belt with a big square brass buckle. Round brass welding goggles with dark green lenses sit up on her forehead.
performance_style: Captain at the helm: feet shoulder-width, weight even. Both arms hang at her sides, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, fingers visible by the thighs. Head level, a wide confident grin.
location: Open alkali playa at dusk: flat cracked pale clay running to the bottom of the frame, a huge welded copper fish-shaped art car parked behind with a jet of orange flame rising from its mouth, far purple mountains and a deep orange sky.
recognition_cues: a hip-length riveted copper-and-brass plate captain's coat with two rows of big brass buttons
round brass welding goggles up on the forehead
avoid: a long flaring or knee-length coat

sing.intent: Surf-psych vocal loop: rock the shoulders in a driving eighth-note bob, raise the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth for a howled phrase, sweep the open character-left hand out low like steering a wheel, then lower the mic to the chest. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing, then return to the opening stance.

animations.flinch: A startled jolt at a sudden flame roar: the shoulders jump up, both open hands rise to chest height, then she laughs it off and settles back into her helm stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: plant the boots wider and raise the character-left forearm across the brass coat front, the character-right hand open at the hip, holding a sturdy grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: march in with a rolling captain's stride, snap a crisp two-finger salute with the character-right hand, then drop into the feet-apart helm stance with both hands open at her sides.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: pull the goggles down to her eyes with both hands, throw both fists above her head and roar with the mouth wide, then hold a triumphant wide-legged pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: the captain's command drains away — the shoulders drop inside the brass coat, both open hands hang limp at her sides, and her head hangs with the chin toward the collar. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish. She remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
